digest.component_or_area: LLM provider factory / OpenAI-compatible endpoint support
propositions: The loud refusal in _pai_check_config raises on any base_url/api_key configuration despite documentation and parsed config support, blocking OpenAI-compatible local endpoints.
An OpenAI builder must be registered conditionally only when base_url is set, injecting the endpoint as provider configuration without making base_url a provider selector.
The builder must override model_profile on an OpenAIProvider subclass to withdraw supports_json_schema_output=False for opaque endpoints, preserving other capabilities.
Bare openai model strings without base_url must continue taking the lazy model-string path to avoid forcing the optional openai SDK as a runtime dependency.
A bare openai:gpt-4o case in the test suite must remain passing and construct no provider when no base_url is configured.
The anthropic provider must still resolve when both REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER=anthropic and REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL are set, proving base_url does not hijack selection.
